name: Shopify App Store Search
description: Search the Shopify App Store by keyword, category slug or app handle/URL and return one typed row per app (handle, name, developer, rating, review count, pricing label, icon, URL; optional details add description, categories, Built for Shopify). No login. Hosted on Apify's MCP server; the tool is the pay-per-event Apify Actor dheerajitbhu/shopify-app-store. Sign in with an Apify account (OAuth); runs are billed to that account.
author: Integration Yard
